name: Pubwork
_note: url: the site's address (no trailing slash). email: the public contact address; empty leaves the contact lines out. kofi = your Ko-fi page name (ko-fi.com/<name>); empty hides the button. ads.client = your AdSense id (ca-pub-…) and ads.slot = an ad unit id; empty means no ads anywhere. source = the public code repository (shown in the footer and on the terms page); empty hides it. umami = the Umami website id for counting visits and actions; empty turns it off. Ads only ever appear on the information pages, never in the editor.
